KUWAIT ENGINEERS FORUM (KEF) is one of the largest professional associations in Kuwait with more than One thousand three hundred Indian Engineers as its members and is a registered association in Indian Embassy.

KEF members hold key positions in the Oil & Gas sector, Power & Utilities sector, Banking & Financial institutions, various Ministries as well as reputed infrastructure and communication companies in the region and contribute immensely to the overall development of the State of Kuwait and to the Society we live in. 

KEF has an insight prologue of all the pros and cons in the lives of expatriates and to improve the social status, well-being and the culture they belong. 

KEF always ventures into new technical advancement including but not limited to the events of Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, Coding etc to bring awareness about the new technological development.

New to this field is the commencement of Mobile Application with the following features;

1) Member contact details - A platform for the KEF members to be in touch with the other members in a fast way.

2) Event announcements - A platform for announcement of the various cultural, sports, seminar etc., activities of KEF and other member alumni association

3) Jobs - A portal for job openings, which is a first-hand information from various reputed organizations in Kuwait where members in every senior position are employed.

4) Event Registrations - Registration for the various events conducted by KEF and individual Alumni’s

5) News - Important alumni news associated with the members and updates on process and procedures for Kuwait Society of Engineers and NBA accreditation.

6) Classifieds - Platform for the members to advertise buying or selling of items like personal items, products or services 

KEF welcome its members, families and all the associates to use this mobile app for the benefit of society and technical development of Kuwait, India and globe at large.
